title: Deuteronomy Bible Quiz - Chapter 21
description: Ten questions on Deuteronomy 21: an unsolved killing, a captive wife, the firstborn's right, and a rebellious son.

questions.text: Who were to come out and measure to the cities when a slain man was found in a field?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says the elders and the judges shall come out and measure to the cities around the slain man.

answers.text: The king's officers
The man's own family
The elders and the judges
The soldiers of the camp

questions.text: Which city's elders were to take a heifer?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says the elders of the city nearest to the slain man shall take a heifer of the herd.

answers.text: The city nearest to the slain man
The largest city of the tribe
The city where the priests lived
The city of the man's father

questions.text: What kind of heifer was to be taken?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 describes a heifer which has not been worked with and has not drawn in the yoke.

answers.text: One that had already given birth to a calf
One that had not been worked or drawn in the yoke
One that was bought from a foreigner
One that was at least three years old

questions.text: Where was the heifer to be brought?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says the elders shall bring it down to a valley with running water, which is neither plowed nor sown.

answers.text: To the altar in the middle of the city
To the top of the nearest mountain
To the gate of the city where the elders sit
To a valley with running water, neither plowed nor sown

questions.text: What did the elders do over the heifer whose neck was broken?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says all the elders of the nearest city shall wash their hands over the heifer.

answers.text: They tore their clothes
They poured oil on it
They washed their hands
They burned it with fire

questions.text: How long was the captive woman to bewail her father and mother?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says she shall remain in the house and bewail her father and her mother a full month.

answers.text: Seven days
A full year
Forty days
A full month

questions.text: What was the man to do if he no longer had delight in the captive woman?
questions.explanation: He was to let her go where she desired; he could not sell her at all for money or deal with her as a slave.

answers.text: Sell her for money
Let her go where she desired
Keep her as a slave
Give her to another man

questions.text: What must a man give to his firstborn son, even if he is the son of the wife he hated?
questions.explanation: Verse 17 says he shall acknowledge the firstborn by giving him a double portion of all that he has.

answers.text: Nothing, if he chooses
Only the land, not the cattle
The same share as the other sons
A double portion of all he has

questions.text: What did the parents of a stubborn and rebellious son tell the elders about him?
questions.explanation: They were to say: "This our son is stubborn and rebellious. He will not obey our voice. He is a glutton and a drunkard."

answers.text: That he is a glutton and a drunkard
That he has stolen from them
That he worships other gods
That he has struck his father

questions.text: What was to be done with the body of a man hanged on a tree?
questions.explanation: His body was not to remain all night on the tree; he was to be buried the same day.

answers.text: It was to stay on the tree three days
It was to be burned outside the camp
It was to be buried the same day
It was to be given to his family after a week
